reviews.title: so much cushion!!
reviews.comment:
This chair is so amazing, there is so much cushioning it feels like your back is being enveloped by clouds. it feels so comfortable and relaxing.
The chair is easy to assemble; I did it alone, so it took a few minutes longer, but it was easily doable. Once it is all together, it feels very sturdy; it doesn't feel cheap or that it might break if you lean back with all your weight (I'm only 150lbs). As mentioned, there are plenty of cushions on the chair, so you can do a long day's work or a heavy gaming session without feeling like your back is in pain. The bonus was that I was able to pay for the chair with 3 monthly payments, which is a help in today's economy for sure. Also, it was scheduled to arrive Monday, the 30th, but it actually arrived 2 days early, which I was pretty surprised by! In closing, I 100% recommend anyone to get this chair! It is absolutely worth every penny.
reviews.author: Brian D.

reviews.title: Best Office Chair I've purchased.
reviews.comment:
The COMHOMA Big and Tall Office Chair is seriously is the most comfortable office chair I've had.  I've bought three different office desk chairs in the past month for our families various rooms and desks:
Costco DPS gaming chair - very comfortable but not super plush.
ULINE Deluxe Leather office chair - Very sturdy, high quality, Great cushions, much heavier duty than the DPS.
COMHOMA Big and Tall Office Chair - This is at least as big as the ULINE, maybe even a little wider, very high quality and absolutely the most comfortable.  And it was the least expensive of the three.  It took the longest to assemble because it had the most parts, but it was still very easy to assemble and high quality.  It's fake leather but looks and feels great!
reviews.author: Benny R. Tate II

reviews.title: This chair is great but has ONE problem!
reviews.comment:
I am a 320lb man who streams and spends my time chronically on the internet/gaming so I am always in my chair except for when I'm not working. Stability and longevity were the main things I was looking for when shopping as my previous chair lasted me 7 or 8 years.
Here is what I like about this chair and then I'll explain a thing or two that I don't:
The chair came with everything that it was supposed to and directions for setup were easy to follow.
The box arrived in good condition and even arrived a day early.
After putting the chair together and taking a seat for the first time, I really felt like I was sitting on a throne.
The arm rests are comfortable and can be raised up high and are adjustable horizontally to accommodate a larger or smaller person.
The Cushions on the back of the chair are soft and offer adequate support.
The Recline is stable even at 320lb and I don't feel like I'm going to fall over or break the chair by leaning back.
Now for the negative:
The cushion LOOKS good but doesn't feel great. Maybe if you weigh less than I do the Seat Cushion will still feel comfortable after prolonged periods of time, but this chair is marketed as "Big and Tall 400lbs" and I sink all the way down to the wood and feel the fatigue of sitting after about an hour and this will only get worse over time as I continue to break the seat in. I'll be purchasing an additional cushion to address this particular shortcoming but figured I would still mention it.
Overall I'm satisfied with the purchase and the price that I paid but can only give the product 4/5 stars.
To the people manufacturing this product, my message to you is spend the extra couple dollars to get some high quality memory foam for the seat and you'll have a 5/5 product.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.title: Stylish, Comfortable, and Surprisingly Better Than My Company's Ergonomic Chair
reviews.comment:
I absolutely love this chair. The pale pink color is beautiful, elegant, and professional-looking, especially on camera during virtual meetings. It adds a nice touch to my workspace, without being overwhelming.
Most importantly, it is extremely comfortable. The lumbar support and footrest make a huge difference during long workdays, and honestly, it has outperformed the much more expensive ergonomic chair my company previously purchased for me.
Assembly was pretty straightforward. My husband and 15-year-old put it together with minimal issues. It wasn't super easy and they definitely needed to use the directions, but not super frustrating by any means.
Overall, this chair exceeded my expectations in both comfort and appearance. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Clifton W.
